snippet.title: CYBERDRIFTER - NOW AVAILABLE ON THE META HORIZON STORE!
snippet.description:
CYBERDRIFTER has launched on the meta horizon store with a new major update!
Grab your data disc and ride your cyber cycle into cyberspace to terminate a virus in this action packed VR game. Launch your disc at the viral force and dodge their volley of laser blasts as you traverse through a retro-stylized virtual world. Also includes 3 cyber mini-games!
meta - https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/pcvr/cyberdrifter/1382713051820964/
